prediction.likelyOutcome: Liability is conceded, so the Kotis Entities will recover just compensation; the live dispute is purely the amount. Given the absence of any competing government valuation and the severity of the physical taking on several high-value parcels, a substantial award close to (but likely somewhat below) the $44,744,774 ask is the most probable outcome, with the exact figure turning on how much the court discounts Dr. Kilpatrick's methodology (cap rate source, comparable sales selection) in response to the rebuttal criticisms, plus statutory interest from the October 2019 taking date on top of whatever principal figure is awarded.

issues.label: Just Compensation Valuation for the ITUR/Railbanking Easement
Interest on the Just Compensation Award

outcome.description: After the valuation trial the Court of Federal Claims adopted Dr. Kilpatrick's before-and-after values for all thirteen parcels but struck his privacy-wall component, awarding just compensation of $42,641,740 (before values $66,179,431, after values $23,537,691) plus interest at the Moody's Aaa corporate bond rate compounded annually, against a demand of $44,744,774; it also denied the government's motion to reopen the record. No attorneys' fees were addressed in this opinion. This is the trial-level decision; no appellate ruling is reflected.
